french.la: Rend la peau du lanceur dure comme un mur de fer. Augmente sa puissance défensive. Les attaques de la cible deviennent plus faciles à esquiver.
french.sv: Rend la peau du lanceur dure comme un mur de fer, ce qui augmente beaucoup sa Défense.

english.la: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, raising its defensive stats. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.
english.sv: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
